verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Clerk serves llms.txt at clerk.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs entry point at clerk.com/docs.md, and the docs are published as .md pages. Clerk also ships llms-full.txt plus changelog and dashboard llms.txt variants, and its /agents page says agents like Codex and Claude Code can be handed the Clerk docs directly. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming these llms.txt/markdown docs.
